info.prompt: Wide-angle shot of the Sandbox's Build-a-Die workstation, where a {geometric|organic|fractal} custom die assembles face-by-face from collected shards, each slotted face emitting a {diffuse|laser-etched|neon-outlined} glow. The RPG node's class badges (Paladin, Rogue, Bard, Artificer) project {stained-glass|circuitry|runic} HUD tints onto the grid, while the Strategy node's Territory Control lines thrum with {pulsing territorial borders|interconnected domain networks|flickering claim markers} between banked tiles.
